title: Probiotic modulation of the tumor glycome in gastrointestinal cancers: insights from MALDI-TOF MS profiling.
snippet: Glycosylation remodeling is a defining hallmark of gastrointestinal (GI) cancers, driving tumor progression, immune evasion, metastatic competency, and therapeutic resistance.
